display_name: Terroir Al Limit Les Tosses, Catalunya
raw_content:
{
  "hook": "Carignan from 80-year-old bush vines rooted in pure llicorella slate at 650 m in the Priorat foothills — that slate is the reason the wine crackles with graphite and blood-orange acidity instead of the usual baked fruit. Dominik Huber ferments whole clusters with zero sulfur, then ages eight months in 3,000 L Austrian foudre: the result is a 12.5 % Priorat that drinks like a Côte-de-Nuits cru with Spanish soul.",
  "wine_summary": "Terroir al Limit rewound Priorat’s clock to 1970, before extraction and alcohol crept north of 15 %. Huber farms biodynamically, picks at 12.5 % potential alcohol, and uses no new oak; the house style is pale, fragrant, and filigree rather than jam. Les Tosses is his steepest Carignan parcel — 45 % gradient, northeast exposure, vines planted 1942 — giving a wine that marries Carignan’s black-olive savor to slate-driven electric acidity. 2022 is already the fifth vintage to hit 97 points, yet only 2,400 bottles exist; most never leave Spain.",
  "terroir_expression": "Llicorella is a 450-million-year-old metamorphic slate that fractures into flat sheets; roots dive three meters to find water, stressing yields to 15 hl/ha. The slate stores daytime heat but, at 650 m, night temperatures drop 15 °C, locking in Carignan’s natural malic acidity. That acidity keeps the iron-rich red soils from tasting metallic, translating instead into a bloody, ferrous edge that frames pomegranate and dried thyme.",
  "vinification_summary": "100 % whole-cluster carbonic maceration lasts 18 days in open Austrian oak fermenters — the intracellular fermentation softens Carignan’s otherwise rasping seed tannins. spontaneous malolactic finishes in 3,000 L foudre, where the wine rests on fine lees for eight months with zero sulfur additions; this keeps the color translucent ruby and the texture feather-fine, more Chambolle than Bandol.",
  "food_pairing": "Nashville hot chicken: slate acidity slices cayenne fat while carbonic fruit cools the burn. Charcoal-grilled lamb skewers rubbed with cumin and dried chile — iron notes echo lamb’s blood flavor, tannin handles smoky crust. Fine-dining: roasted pigeon with black-olive tapenade; Carignan’s olive savor mirrors the tapenade, acidity lifts game richness. Catalan classic: calcots (spring onions) roasted over vine embers and romesco; sweet onion and almond need that blood-orange snap. Fast casual: pepperoni pizza with chili honey — same hot-sweet-acid tango.",
  "comparable_wines": "Clos Mogador Manyetes 2020 — also high-slate Priorat Carignan but raised 18 months in barrel, darker and more powerful. Anne Gros & Jean-Paul Tollot Les Fontanilles 2021 — Minervois Carignan on limestone, fleshier, less graphite. Arnot-Roberts Fellom Ranch Carignan 2021 — Mendocino whole-cluster, similar pale hue and floral lift, but California warmth shows more blueberry.",
  "style_profile": "Medium-bodied dry red with bright acidity and slate-driven mineral edge",
  "cellar_recommendation": "Drink 2025-2032; no decant needed. Keep at 12 °C; the wine is bottled with 20 ppm free SO₂ — fragile and best stored below 14 °C.",
  "value_assessment": "€110-130 in Europe, $140-160 in the US. At that tag you’re paying less than 2018 Clos Erasmus ($220) for similar terroir and half the alcohol. Worth it if you value lift over lash, but Château-Musar-loving hedonists will find it skinny.",
  "market_position": "You’ll spot it by-the-glass at Barcelona’s Disfrutar and on the collector wall of San Francisco’s Flatiron, but rarely in between. Sommeliers use it to show a fresh face of Priorat; private clients buy it by the six-pack to cellar.",
  "insider_take": "Most buyers still expect Priorat to punch like Port; serve this blind and they guess Burgundy. If you want velvet, buy 2016 Clos i Terrasses instead — Les Tosses trades weight for tension and wins only if you value nerve over nap.",
  "aging_potential_years": 10,
  "drinking_window_min_years": 3,
  "drinking_window_max_years": 10,
  "sensory": {
    "acidity": 4,
    "tannin": 3,

    "color_intensity": "medium",
    "aroma_intensity": "pronounced",

  }
}
